verdict.rationale: Letta explicitly documents shared memory repositories ('letta shared-memory create --name team-memory') giving multiple agents access to the same files/working context, implying private agent memory stays separate unless explicitly shared (letta-docs-8, 21, 29). However, there is no documentation of per-user access control, permissions granularity, or explicit guarantees that private memory blocks stay isolated from other users/teams beyond agent-level separation — missing for 10: fine-grained ACLs for shared memory, multi-user permission scoping, and independent/hands-on confirmation that private memory cannot leak into shared repos.
